prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Summary of key proposals in the Green Party Manifesto 2024 (ideological framing removed)

Health and care
- NHS: Reduce waiting lists; rapid GP access (same-day for urgent need); universal NHS dentistry; increase NHS staff pay; restore public health budgets; invest ~£8bn extra in year one in England, rising to £28bn by 2030; at least £20bn capital over five years.
- Primary care and diagnostics: Increase funding to GPs (reaching £1.5bn/yr by 2030); £2bn capital for primary care; expand community diagnostics.
- Dentistry: New NHS contract; additional investment reaching £3bn/yr by 2030; preventative hubs and free dental nursing for children/low-income groups.
- Mental health: Access to evidence-based therapies within 28 days; funded school/college counsellors; tailored services for specific groups.
- Cancer: National plan to boost early diagnosis and treatment.
- Assisted dying: Support legal change with safeguards.
- HIV: End new transmissions by 2030 via prevention and testing.
- Social care: Free personal care; workforce pay/career structure; £20bn/yr investment. Children’s social care: +£3bn/yr.
- Disability: +5% to disability benefits; retain cash PIP; reform assessments; mandatory free SEND transport (16–18).

Housing and planning
- Build 150,000 new social homes per year; end Right to Buy; powers for rent controls; end Section 21; tenancy dispute boards.
- Retrofit and resilience: Over five years—£29bn for home insulation (to EPC B), £4bn public buildings, £9bn low‑carbon heat, £7bn overheating adaptation; area-based, LA-led rollout.
- New-build standards: Passivhaus-equivalent; solar and low‑carbon heat mandated; whole-life carbon reporting; protect green spaces/Green Belt; reuse-first on demolition.

Energy and climate
- No new oil/gas licences; carbon tax rising over a decade; end fossil subsidies.
- Renewables targets: By 2035—80 GW offshore wind, 53 GW onshore wind, 100 GW solar; wind ~70% of electricity by 2030; lift onshore wind barriers; strengthen community ownership.
- Grid/storage: Expand grid, interconnectors, and storage; develop green hydrogen for industry.
- Nuclear: Stop new projects; phase out existing; tighter bioenergy rules; end imported biomass for power.
- Crown Estate into public ownership; devolve Welsh marine assets.

Economy, taxes, and public ownership
- Green investment: Average ~£40bn/yr over parliament for power, retrofit, rail, public transport, active travel, industry decarbonisation, water/sewage.
- Public ownership: Rail, water companies, and Big 5 retail energy suppliers.
- Finance: Bank of England mandate to support transition; fossil divestment by 2030 across regulated finance.
- SMEs: Regional mutual banks (capitalised via UKIB and £10bn); prompt payment law; grants for business decarbonisation.
- Circular economy: Right to repair; 10‑year warranties; top-efficiency product standards.
- Welfare: +£40/week to UC/legacy benefits; scrap five‑week wait and two‑child cap; disability +5%; uprate pensions with inflation/wages; raise Carer’s Allowance; end sanctions; long-term UBI ambition.
- Tax: Annual wealth tax (1% >£10m; 2% >£1bn); align CGT and investment income with earned rates; remove NI upper earnings limit; reform inheritance tax; council tax revaluation; carbon tax (from £120/t to up to £500/t in 10 years); stronger anti-avoidance; borrow to invest.

Transport
- Public transport: Raise subsidies to £10bn/yr by end of parliament; free buses for under‑18s; £19bn over five years for public transport and active travel; rail renationalisation; local control of buses; £2.5bn/yr for cycle/walking.
- Roads/EVs: No new road-building; restore fuel duty escalator; road pricing; end new ICE car sales by 2027; ICE off roads by 2035; £5bn/yr EV scrappage by end of parliament; 20 mph default in built-up areas; weight‑based VED; expand rail freight.
- Aviation: Frequent-flyer levy; ban domestic flights where rail <3 hours; apply carbon tax to kerosene; halt airport expansion.

Nature, animals, food
- Nature: Rights of Nature Act; 30% land/sea protected by 2030; rewet peat; expand woodland; urban nature measures; Clean Air Act; water companies to public ownership; +£1.5bn to DEFRA; stronger river/sea protections; ban destructive fishing in MPAs.
- Animals: Commission on Animal Protection; ban blood sports; tighten breeding/imports; end routine antibiotics/cages; ban lead ammo.
- Food/farming: Nearly triple farm support to transition to nature-friendly farming; expand horticulture; reduce pesticides; free school meals for all and breakfast clubs to Year 6; local food partnerships; stronger Groceries Code Adjudicator.

Education
- Early years: £1.4bn/yr for Sure Start; extend funded childcare to 35 hours from 9 months (sector-negotiated).
- Schools: +£8bn (incl. £2bn teacher pay); £2.5bn/yr for buildings/RAAC; broaden curriculum; abolish high-stakes testing/Ofsted; move academies to LA control; VAT on private school fees (SEN exempt); SEND investment £5bn; school nurses and counsellors.
- Post‑16/FE/HE: Sixth‑form +£3bn; FE skills +£12bn; restore EMA; scrap tuition fees; restore maintenance grants.

Rights, democracy, migration
- Fair Politics Act: PR voting; repeal voter ID; party funding reform; transparency rules; votes at 16; replace House of Lords with elected chamber; more devolution; +£5bn/yr for English local government.
- Human rights: Protect HRA/ECHR; restore legal aid; scrap recent protest-curbing laws; support trans self‑ID.
- Migration/asylum: End hostile environment; safe routes; right to work for asylum seekers; end NRPF; simplify/at-cost fees; free NHS access for visa holders; permit family accompaniment; create Department of Migration.

Justice and policing
- Trust in policing: End routine stop and search and facial recognition; stronger accountability and diversity standards.
- Courts/prisons: Restore MoJ budget (including £2.5bn for courts); recruit judges; presumption against custodial sentences <2 years; expand diversion/restorative justice; decriminalise personal drug possession.
- VAWG: Make misogyny a hate crime; national strategy; fund local services.

Foreign policy
- International law focus; support Ukraine; reform European security.
- Israel/Palestine: Immediate bilateral ceasefire; recognise Palestine; end UK arms exports to Israel; support war‑crimes investigations.
- Aid/climate finance: Aid to 1% GNI and climate finance to 1.5% GNI by 2033; Loss and Damage fund; debt relief; ecocide law; Global South leadership.
- Trade: Remove investor‑state dispute systems; uphold UK standards.
- Europe: Aim to rejoin EU; first rejoin Customs Union; restore free movement; rejoin Erasmus.
- Defence: Join UN TPNW; cancel Trident; work within NATO for no‑first‑use and defence‑only posture.
